name: ISS A/S
summary: ISS A/S operates as workplace experience and facility management company in the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Switzerland, Germany, Australia, New Zealand, Türkiye, Spain, Denmark, and internationally. The company offers space office, space plus, and space production; transportation and infrastructure cleaning, food hygiene, and hospitality and cleaning services; and catering, fine dining and event catering; and micro-kitchens and vending services, as well as operates restaurants and pop-ups.
